messages:
Harper Jones: Quick sync  we're locking publish for the benchmark blog + analyst brief next Tue 08:00 PT. Key asks: localized press packs (EN/DE/FR), an analyst embargo at 07:30 PT, and a 1-page sales enable for AMER/EU.
Eli Navarro: Got it. I'll own analyst outreach and monitor replies 07:0010:00 PT. Who's prepping the analyst one-pager?
Tali Nguyen: I'll draft the sales 1-pager and the AMER play. Jordan, can you add EU notes?
Jordan (sales): On it. Will add EU talking points and quick objection-handling bullets. ETA EOD today.
Samir Kahn: Localization team note: we can do EN/DE/FR but need final copy by EOD Monday to meet Tuesday publish. Also can provide translated social blurbs.
Harper Jones: Please use neutral language; exec comms flagged the CEO quote for tone. Legal wanted to remove "best" claims and any hard customer numbers.
LegalBot: Legal check: remove absolute comparisons and client count lines. Replace with "multiple customers" or "early adopters". Also add line offering methodology on request.
Eli Navarro: For analysts: propose a 15-min embargoed briefing at 07:40 PT. Panel: CTO + Head of Research. Good?
Samir Kahn: CTO video clip requested for the analyst brief  can we pre-record a 90s clip explaining methodology? I can handle captions for DE/FR.
Tali Nguyen: I'll coordinate with filming. Need a quick script for CTO. Harper, can you/Harper comms draft a short script?
Harper Jones: Drafting now, will post in the PR drive: https://drive.redwood/pr/bench-analyst-brief-v1. Keep it high-level; cite methodology availability.
press-bot: Embargo set: 2026-06-15T07:30:00Z. Auto-hold on scheduled social posts until manual resume. Monitoring enabled.
Jordan (sales): Heads-up: a partner in EMEA asked for preview assets for enablement. We should give only the one-pager, no dataset or numbers.
Samir Kahn: Confirming partners get only localized one-pager and hero images (no raw numbers). We'll watermark preview assets with "Embargoed".
Eli Navarro: Analyst ask: one analyst wants to cite a headline stat. Legal says provide only the reactive quote: "Our internal benchmarks show meaningful latency and cost improvements; see methodology on publish."
Tali Nguyen: Social plan: initial posts at publish + engineer thread 45m after. Samir, please provide localized three-line social copies.
Samir Kahn: Will deliver EN/DE/FR social blurbs by EOD Monday.
Harper Jones: Ops note: use #press-watch during the hour and #analyst-brief for embargoed invites. If anything breaks, escalate to exec-comm and ping Legal.
press-bot: Publish job created: job-id=pb-2026-0615-08. Status=scheduled. Auto-resume requires Harper or Eli.
Eli Navarro: Final logistics  I'll send calendar invites to analysts with Zoom link and embed the pre-recorded clip if we have it. Also will collect any pre-brief questions to route to Research.
Harper Jones: Thanks team. Final sign-off check Monday 16:00 PT in this thread. If no open issues by then, we proceed with Tuesday publish at 08:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
